question: What initialization vector does published ntfs-3g code use for one AES-256 EFS sector?
allowedInputs: https://docs.rs/crate/ntfs-3g-sys/0.1.0/source/vendor/ntfs-3g/ntfsprogs/ntfsdecrypt.c ntfs_fek_encrypt_sector and ntfs_fek_decrypt_sector add the file byte offset to 0x5816657be9161312 and 0x1989adbe44918961, then use that pair as the IV for one 512-byte AES-256-CBC sector.
